from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlowItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash flow line item related to investing activities from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reporting the data")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the report (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the cash flow line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount as extracted; negative values should be negative floats")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flows: list[InvestingCashFlowItem]
